rows.detail: Request ID must be unique and slot-scoped
Request type must be canonical_shared_runner_restart_request
Repository must equal cagdascagdas100/chat_gpt_clone_1
Branch must equal main
Slot must equal height_difference_3
Canonical historical starter path must be exact
Starter blob must equal ed8092e7...
Canonical wrapper must be root devam.ps1
devam.ps1 blob must equal 9a8542a0...
Runner must be existing V4 shared runner
V4 runner blob must equal c2b9a44e...
Requested queue path must be exact Priority-2 file
Requested task ID must be exact
Priority-2 blob must equal 6373d1ea...
Priority-2 status must remain pickup_requested
Priority must remain 2
Starter must request MaxTasks=1
Stale-lock threshold must remain 20 minutes
New or parallel runner creation must be forbidden
Scheduled task may be used only after exact existing task discovery
Register-ScheduledTask and schtasks /create are forbidden
Start-ScheduledTask or schtasks /run may target only a discovered existing canonical task
The request file alone is never host-liveness evidence
Starter result file must be newer than request
Shared heartbeat must be newer than request
Heartbeat runner must equal V4 canonical runner
Heartbeat PID must be a positive integer
Shared latest status must be newer than request
Shared status queue_seen must be true
Shared status queue_started must be true
Slot preflight output must be fresh and nonempty
Outer watchdog output must be fresh and nonempty
Either valid canonical checkpoint or explicit bounded blocker required
No request storm; one active request until ack or explicit failure
Request and mirror state must be written atomically or by serialized SHA update
No business rows, DB write, deployment, fake data or final-ready claim
